title: People Services Senior Specialist
description:
**About AkzoNobel**
 Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long\-established paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.
   

  

 For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com
   

  

 © 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 Serve as the administrative specialist in People Services. Retrieve, administrate and control the Workforce Administration from Hire to Retire (the employee life cycle). Handle complex customer cases in line with turn\-around time SLA’s, quality standards and policies. Apply specialist expertise to resolve specific cases and escalate/refer cases to the Center of Expertise as appropriate. Conduct Root cause analysis and support transition and automation projects.
   

  

**Key Activities**
 Provide administrative support to employee life cycle changes such as: new hires, transfers, promotions, terminations, organizational changes (OM) and data management. Apply specialist expertise to cases from AkzoNobel employees and managers that cannot be solved by the Contact Center.
   

  

* Execute the administrative activities related to employee life cycle changes (i.e. administering new hires, transfers, promotions, terminations, organizational changes (OM) and data management
* Create employment contracts, letters and memos according to business requests
* Update the employee records and keeping all relevant systems and (third) parties up to date
* Provide expertise on global and local policies and procedures
* Provide expertise support to the Contact Center to resolve cases/queries within agreed SLAs.
* Coordinate and resolve complex cases
* Assist to translate and implement policies from the Center of Expertise into transactional processes and services that can be performed by People Services
* Spot opportunities for improvement of processes and systems via input to the team lead.
* Drive Simplification and Automation
* Participate in transition projects
* Conduct root cause analysis and fix process issues
* Ensure KB and SOPs are kept up to date


**Experience**
* Minimal 10 years of relevant working experience
* Bachelors/Master’s degree preferably in HR
* Strong customer services orientation
* Ability to interpret and apply the HR policies and procedures
* Flexible and stress resistant: The ability to multitask and structure the workload
* Accurate, self\-standing and with strong attention to detail
* Experience with HR supporting technology and the capability to quickly learn and adapt to new ways of working
* Eager to learn and keep pace with developments in labour relations
* Strong oral, written and interpersonal communication skills and confidence to effectively work with all levels of the organization (including external parties where necessary)
* Ability to work in an international and multicultural environment
* Fluent in English language, both written and verbally is required
* Fluent in French or German language when supporting France or Germany, both written and verbally is required


 At AkzoNobel we are highly committed to ensuring an inclusive and respectful workplace where all employees can be their best self. We strive to embrace diversity in a context of tolerance. Our talent acquisition process plays an integral part in this journey, as setting the foundations for a diverse environment. For this reason we train and educate on the implications of our Unconscious Bias in order for our TA and hiring managers to be mindful of them and take corrective actions when applicable. In our organization, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

title: Contingent Workforce Manager
description:
Location: Pune, India
 



 Experience: 8–12 Years
 



 Industry: Global Enterprise / Fortune 500
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



 Level: Manager / Senior Manager
 








**About HummingBird** 




 HummingBird, an AI\-powered Total Talent Workforce Platform powered by LanceSoft, helps enterprises transform how they source, engage, manage, and optimize their workforce.
 



 Built for complex enterprise hiring environments, HummingBird brings together AI\-powered talent matching, workforce analytics, recruitment automation, and integrated talent management capabilities to support permanent, contingent, and Statement of Work (SOW) workforce programs.
 



 HummingBird is hiring on behalf of its client, a Fortune 500 company, for an experienced Contingent Workforce Program Manager based in Pune.
 








**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an accomplished Contingent Workforce Program Manager with 8–12 years of experience in managing enterprise contingent workforce programs, vendor ecosystems, workforce operations, and compliance frameworks.
 



 The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Managed Service Provider (MSP) programs, Vendor Management Systems (VMS), contingent workforce governance, supplier management, workforce analytics, and cost optimization.
 



 This role will be responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end contingent workforce lifecycle, driving operational excellence, strengthening supplier partnerships, and ensuring workforce programs align with organizational objectives.
 








**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Contingent Workforce Strategy \& Program Management** 



* Develop and execute contingent workforce strategies aligned with enterprise workforce objectives.
* Manage end\-to\-end contingent workforce programs covering sourcing, onboarding, engagement, extensions, and offboarding.
* Establish scalable operating models for contingent labor management across business functions.
* Drive standardization of workforce processes, policies, and governance frameworks.
* Partner with business leaders to understand workforce requirements and optimize contingent talent utilization.



**2\. MSP \& VMS Management** 



* Oversee Managed Service Provider (MSP) relationships and program performance.
* Manage and optimize Vendor Management Systems (VMS) such as SAP Fieldglass, Beeline, or equivalent platforms.
* Ensure effective requisition management, supplier distribution, candidate submissions, approvals, and onboarding workflows.
* Monitor MSP service delivery against established SLAs and KPIs.
* Identify opportunities for process automation and operational improvements.



**3\. Supplier \& Vendor Management** 



* Develop and manage a high\-performing contingent workforce supplier ecosystem.
* Conduct supplier performance reviews and establish measurable scorecards.
* Monitor supplier quality, responsiveness, fulfillment rates, and compliance.
* Support supplier selection, onboarding, contract negotiations, and performance improvement.
* Drive supplier rationalization and strategic vendor partnerships where appropriate.



**4\. Workforce Compliance \& Risk Management** 



* Ensure contingent workforce programs comply with applicable labor laws, contractual obligations, and enterprise policies.
* Establish governance for worker classification, tenure management, onboarding documentation, and offboarding.
* Collaborate with Legal, HR, Procurement, Finance, and Compliance teams to mitigate workforce\-related risks.
* Maintain appropriate audit trails, documentation, and compliance reporting.
* Support governance for Independent Contractors (IC), temporary workers, and SOW engagements.



**5\. Financial Management \& Cost Optimization** 



* Manage contingent workforce budgets, spend visibility, and cost\-control initiatives.
* Analyze labor rates, supplier markups, workforce utilization, and program expenditures.
* Develop rate\-card governance and support commercial negotiations.
* Identify opportunities for cost savings through supplier optimization, process improvements, and workforce planning.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.



**6\. Workforce Analytics \& Reporting** 



* Establish and monitor key contingent workforce metrics, including:
* Time\-to\-fill and requisition aging
* Supplier fulfillment and submission quality
* Contingent workforce spend
* Cost savings and cost avoidance
* Worker tenure and utilization
* Compliance adherence
* Hiring manager satisfaction
* MSP and supplier SLA performance
* Develop executive dashboards and management reports.
* Leverage workforce analytics to improve decision\-making and program effectiveness.



**7\. Stakeholder Management** 



* Partner with Procurement, HR, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Legal, and business leadership.
* Act as the primary point of contact for contingent workforce program operations.
* Facilitate governance meetings, supplier reviews, and program performance discussions.
* Provide guidance to hiring managers on contingent workforce policies and processes.
* Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external workforce partners.



**8\. Program Transformation \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Identify opportunities to enhance workforce program efficiency through automation, AI, and digital technologies.
* Support MSP/VMS implementation, migration, or optimization initiatives.
* Drive continuous improvement across sourcing, onboarding, supplier management, and compliance.
* Contribute to Total Talent Management initiatives integrating permanent and contingent workforce strategies.








**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, or a related discipline.
* 8–12 years of experience in Contingent Workforce Management, MSP Program Management, Workforce Operations, or Strategic Procurement.
* Proven experience managing enterprise\-scale contingent workforce programs.
* Strong understanding of MSP operating models and VMS platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP Fieldglass, Beeline, or similar workforce management systems.
* Experience managing staffing suppliers and vendor performance.
* Strong knowledge of contingent workforce compliance, worker classification, and contractual governance.
* Experience managing workforce spend, rate cards, supplier commercials, and program budgets.
* Strong analytical, reporting, and stakeholder\-management capabilities.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.








**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience working within a Fortune 500 company, global MNC, or large enterprise environment.
* Experience managing multi\-location or global contingent workforce programs.
* Exposure to Direct Sourcing, Independent Contractor Compliance, and SOW management.
* Experience implementing or transforming MSP/VMS programs.
* Familiarity with Total Talent Management and workforce planning.
* Experience using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar reporting tools.
* Understanding of AI\-enabled workforce management and recruitment automation.








**Key Leadership Competencies** 



* Strategic workforce planning
* Supplier relationship management
* Strong commercial and financial acumen
* Cross\-functional stakeholder engagement
* Data\-driven decision\-making
* Risk management and compliance
* Program governance and operational excellence
* Change management and process transformation








**Why This Opportunity?** 



* Manage a strategic contingent workforce program for a Fortune 500 organization.
* Work with global stakeholders and enterprise workforce management teams.
* Gain exposure to large\-scale MSP, VMS, and Total Talent initiatives.
* Drive workforce transformation through AI, automation, and advanced analytics.
* Contribute to enterprise\-wide workforce efficiency, compliance, and cost optimization.

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
As an HR Executive, you will work closely with the
 **HR Manager, hiring managers, technical teams, employees and candidates** 
 . You will be responsible for supporting the recruitment process and ensuring a smooth experience for candidates and internal stakeholders.
   

  

 You will also get hands\-on exposure to HR operations, employee engagement, HR documentation, performance management and statutory processes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Recruitment – Primary Responsibility**
* Understand hiring requirements and job specifications from hiring managers and technical teams.
* Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, employee referrals, job portals and other relevant channels.
* Screen and shortlist candidates based on technical skills, experience and role requirements.
* Coordinate technical interviews and manage interviewer schedules.
* Follow up with hiring managers and interviewers for timely feedback.
* Maintain candidate pipelines, recruitment trackers and recruitment\-related documentation.
* Coordinate with candidates throughout the recruitment process and ensure timely communication.
* Support salary discussions and offer closure in coordination with the HR Manager.
* Coordinate offer documentation, pre\-joining communication and onboarding formalities.
* Maintain regular follow\-up with selected candidates to ensure a smooth joining process.


**HR Operations**
* Maintain employee records, personnel files and HR documentation.
* Support onboarding, confirmation, transfers and exit\-related processes.
* Assist with attendance and leave\-related activities.
* Respond to routine employee HR queries and escalate sensitive matters to the HR Manager.
* Assist in preparing HR reports, trackers and other HR documentation.


**Employee Engagement \& HR Initiatives**
* Support employee engagement activities, employee surveys and recognition initiatives.
* Assist in planning and coordinating employee events and team activities.


**What We're Looking For**
* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent qualification.
* 1–2 years of experience in Human Resources, preferably with hands\-on experience in technical recruitment.
* Good understanding of the end\-to\-end recruitment process.
* Experience using recruitment platforms such as Naukri, LinkedIn or other sourcing channels.
* Ability to understand technical job requirements and identify relevant candidate profiles.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Good interpersonal and relationship\-building skills.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination abilities.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple hiring requirements simultaneously.
* Basic understanding of HR operations and employee lifecycle processes.
* Good working knowledge of MS Office and recruitment/HR tools.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of employee and organizational information.
* Proactive attitude and willingness to learn and take on broader HR responsibilities.


**What You'll Gain**
* Hands\-on experience in technical recruitment within a growing technology organization.
* Exposure to the complete employee lifecycle beyond recruitment.
* Opportunity to work closely with hiring managers and technical teams.
* Exposure to employee engagement and HR operations.
* Opportunity to develop into a well\-rounded HR professional with experience across both Talent Acquisition and HR Operations.
* A dynamic and supportive environment with opportunities to learn and take on additional responsibilities.


**Who Would Be a Good Fit?**
 We are looking for someone who is
 **curious, organized, proactive and comfortable taking ownership of assigned responsibilities** 
 .
   

  

 If you enjoy interacting with people, have a genuine interest in recruitment and want to build a broader career in HR, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Breach Management
description:
Join us as an
 **Employee Breach \& Conduct Rules** 
 professional, responsible for supporting the Head of Employee Breach \& Conduct Rules in delivering activities aligned to the Compliance Investigations \& Insights strategic book of work.
   

  

 The Team acts as the firm's centre of excellence for employee conduct risk, providing expert advice, behavioural insights, and strategic guidance on employee conduct matters. The team supports Control Functions and business leaders in interpreting, escalating, and remediating conduct issues, and drives continuous improvement in the firm's conduct culture.
   

  

 The role holder will provide delivery, oversight and check and challenge on business and compliance matters to evidence that the organisation is operating in compliance with Barclays legal, regulatory and ethical responsibilities.
   

  

 To be successful as an Employee Breach \& Conduct Rules professional, you should have:
   

  

  

* Understanding of the Conduct Risk Framework.
* Ability to multitask and manage projects while completing daily tasks and responsibilities.
* Must have an execution mindset and an understanding of the role compliance plays in Employee Conduct.
* Attention to detail, strong analytical skills and a diligent approach to understanding and confirming facts.
* Ability to consistently demonstrate sound judgement and confident, risk\-based decision making.
* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, being able to communicate confidently and effectively with colleagues and stakeholders at all levels, both verbally and in writing.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Ability to engage, organise, and support stakeholder meetings in order to establish and influence outcomes.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously with accuracy and professionalism, in a fast paced environment.
* Sound judgement together with strong communication, influencing and interpersonal skills to work with and support others effectively, driving behavioural change.
* Curious mindset, ability to work accurately and at pace with team members and stakeholders.
* Confident and excellent communication skills.
* Strong influencer.
* Reliable, dependable, accountable.
* Strong Team Player.
* Ambitious, intelligent and hard working individual.


 Critical Skills Statement
   

  

 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as:
   

  

  

* Assess sensitive conduct cases and escalation decisions, ensuring proportionality and consistency in behavioural assessments.
* Interpret behavioural trends and provide recommendations to reduce conduct risk and enhance the conduct culture.
* Support consistency in the application of conduct standards across the organisation by providing subject matter expertise to Policy Reinforcers, Employee Relations, and other stakeholders.
* Manage and influence a range of stakeholders.
* Work closely with cross function Operational Leads to support in activities such as the documentation of process and procedures, optimisation and data Governance.
* Support the transformation of Global Breach Management along with the existing Conduct Rules framework to achieve the right outcomes.


**This role is based in Pune.**
**Purpose of the role**
 To investigate employee conduct exceptions, provide oversight \& advice and mitigate compliance risks. Help maintain a culture of employee integrity and compliance within the organisation through delivery of appropriate training and execution of controls.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and implementation of policies related to employee conduct that aligns with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
* Implementation of surveillance and monitoring systems to track and report on employee behaviour.
* Development of training programmes to educate employees on conduct expectations, ethical standards, and regulatory obligations.
* Completion of task and exceptions from the following areas Breach Management \& Reward, Global Registrations (including the UK Senior Managers Regime), Conduct Rules, Mandatory Block Leave and Personal Investments \& Affiliations to ensure oversight of relevant Employee Conduct policy and standards.
* Development and implementation of controls related to employee conduct that aligns with regulatory requirements and Barclays’ risk appetite and industry best practices.
* Provision of advice and assistance across Barclays on matters that relating to employee conduct.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

description:

title: Recruitment Manager
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 We're looking for a Recruitment Manager to take full ownership of day\-to\-day delivery. You'll lead our team leaders and recruiting team, run daily operations, manage client delivery, and make sure mandates convert into closures. This is a hands\-on role. You'll screen, guide and personally close senior mandates, not just supervise.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Team leadership and performance** 



* Lead the team leaders and recruiters: set daily and weekly targets for sourcing, submissions, interviews and closures.
* Track individual and team performance, spot gaps early, and coach, correct or escalate as needed.
* Run daily team operations: mandate allocation, prioritisation, and resolving day\-to\-day queries and blockers.
* Ensure every new mandate gets a first client submission within 48 hours of receipt.



  





**JD understanding and mandate briefing** 



* Break down client JDs into must\-haves, good\-to\-haves and deal\-breakers before sourcing starts.
* Brief the team on each mandate and review early submissions to correct misalignment quickly.



  





**2nd\-level screening and submissions** 



* Conduct or oversee L2 screening, personally handling senior and leadership roles.
* Ensure only quality\-checked profiles reach clients, with accurate candidate summaries and flagged gaps.



  





**Leadership hiring** 



* Personally handle department\-head, manager and senior mandates, including search, assessment, compensation discussions and closure.
* Manage offer negotiation and pre\-joining engagement to reduce dropouts.



  





**Client engagement** 



* Be the delivery point of contact for clients: requirement calls, feedback follow\-ups, interview coordination and escalations.
* Build client trust through fast TAT and relevant submissions.



  





**Reporting** 



* Own daily and weekly client reports and internal MIS: pipeline, submissions, interviews and closures.
* Keep ATS data accurate and current across the team.
* Share a weekly delivery review with the founder.



  





**REQUIREMENTS** 



* 5\+ years in recruitment, with a significant portion at a recruitment agency or consulting firm. Corporate\-only HR/TA backgrounds will not be considered.

**Role And Responsibilities**
**Integrated Facility management**
* Plan, manage, and oversee day\-to\-day workplace operations for assigned locations.
* Conduct daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly service reviews with service partner teams. Ensure delivery of daily onsite facility management services including asset management, engineering, building maintenance, cleaning, office services, mail delivery, logistics and storage services.

* Monitor and document MIS/reporting processes, including weekly/fortnightly/monthly /quarterly calendars.
* Deploy global changes to policies, operating models, and best practices.
* Maintain a healthy working environment, and foster employee productivity by ensuring a functional, safe, and engaging workplace.


**Engineering and Technical Services**
* Oversee engineering infrastructure and keep a track of service partners performance by reviewing the uptime of all engineering assets and performance as per agreed OLA’s.
* Collaborate on R\&M planning, and drive OPEX/CAPEX initiatives aligned with sustainability and safety.
* Track and manage M \& E Opex and Capex budgets for engineering services efficiently.
* Support implementation of sustainability and energy efficiency initiatives.


**Statutory Compliance and Risks**
* Ensure compliance with all statutory norms and third\-party vendor (TPV) legal requirements.
* Liaise with all stakeholders/teams who are part of the process: Legal, HR, TPV, AEE, Contract Management, and Commercial teams to fulfil obligations.
* Track license renewals (e.g. lifts, fire NOCs, building safety, water quality, etc.).
* Maintain documentation for health, safety, and environment\-related regulations.
* Lead responses to all audits—internal, external, client, statutory, and process audits covering the workplace operations.


**Corporate Real Estate (CRE)**
* Engage with landlords on all operational issues and lease terms on a monthly basis.
* Ensure all contractual obligations are being fulfilled by both parties.
* Escalate RE MSA or CAM related issues or violations to CRE leads.
* Support site selection and site disposition and extend all necessary support to Workplace leads , CRE POC, Controllership and Procurement, including risk\-free handovers and formal process closure.
* Coordinate with CRE, procurement, and finance during acquisition/disposition.


**Workplace Governance and Client Relationship Management**
* Conduct structured CRM connects with key business stakeholders (DU Leads, MDs, SDLs, etc.).
* Present KPI delivery metrics and track escalation resolution within a reasonable time frame (SNOW, M \& E, Events, Travel, etc.).
* Monitor and drive monthly client engagement activities (townhalls, bay walks, FGDs).
* Maintain strong client satisfaction by acting on feedback and enabling resolution of workplace issues.


**Security, EHS, and Business Continuity**
* Oversee physical and electronic security controls, including CCTV, access controls, and fire safety.
* Lead response efforts during BCP or crisis events and participate in LMT calls.
* Ensure site compliance with EHS protocols and wellness standards.
* Supervise wellness facilities such as gyms, wellness rooms, ambulance support, etc.


**Cafeteria Management**
* Oversee aggregator managed cafeteria operations and ensure compliance to the SLAs. Oversee vendor selection, hygiene and sanitation standards, and quality of food and ensure adherence to EHS and GAP standards, and other statutory compliance.
* Lead Food Committee Reviews and ensure feedback is acted upon by the vendor .
* Oversee licenses and documentation for food services.


**Team Management**
* Right\-size direct and extended vendor teams; ensure role clarity and workload balance.
* Ensure timely completion of mandatory training programs for all personnel, both direct and TPV service partner teams.
* Deliver feedback and performance reviews to the team members and drive team engagement activities.
* Promote a culture of innovation and employee well\-being.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Special Events**
* Extend support for high\-profile visits, including global leaders and clients.
* Participate in showcasing workplace capabilities during such events.
* Liaise with SMT, P\+ teams, and central/managed services (Events, CPSM, Travel) to ensure operational harmony.


**Projects and Transitions**
* Oversee seamless handover of newly completed WP projects into operations.
* Actively contribute during transition stages to ensure business readiness.


**Professional \& Technical Skills:**
* Strong leadership and team management skills with a track record of driving operational excellence.
* Strong organisational and planning skills with attention to detail.
* Proven experience in managing multi\-disciplinary teams and external stakeholders.
* Effective communication (English, Hindi, and preferably Marathi) and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving, decision\-making, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and reporting abilities (MIS, KPIs, OLAs).
* Crisis management and business continuity planning (BCP) experience.
* Change management and adaptability to global process changes.
* Strong presentation and documentation skills.
* Proficient in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, word, working knowledge of Power BI and Power Apps preferred.


**Additional Information:**
* The ideal candidate should be a person of high integrity and moral values with strong leadership skills.
* This position is based out of Pune offices.

title: Recruitment Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 Minimac Systems Pvt. Ltd., incorporated in 2012 and registered as an MSME under NSIC, is a leading provider of end\-to\-end lubrication reliability solutions. The company offers technical consulting, training, services, and manufacturing of systems for oil purification, filtration, flushing, OEM filter replacements, and oil testing devices, along with Minimac Operations \& Maintenance Services (MOMS). Guided by a strong focus on Clean Tech and ESG, Minimac leverages IoT and AI tools to enable data\-driven maintenance and reliability decisions. With a growing global presence across Asia, the Middle East \& Caspian, North Africa, South\-East Asia, and Australia, Minimac is committed to decarbonizing the lubricant life cycle and delivering high\-quality, timely solutions that create customer joy and empower people.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Recruitment Specialist role based in the Pune Division. The Recruitment Specialist will manage the end\-to\-end hiring process, including sourcing candidates, screening resumes, coordinating and conducting interviews, and supporting selection decisions in collaboration with hiring managers. The role involves maintaining candidate pipelines, updating recruitment trackers, and ensuring a positive, inclusive candidate experience. The Recruitment Specialist will also assist with onboarding activities, coordinate training schedules for new hires, and contribute to continuous improvement of recruitment practices aligned with the company’s values and growth objectives.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Recruiting and Hiring skills to manage end\-to\-end talent acquisition.
* Candidates should possess effective Interviewing and Communication skills to assess fit and engage with candidates and stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess Training and onboarding support skills to help new hires integrate smoothly into the organization.
* Relevant experience in recruitment, HR, or talent acquisition within technical or industrial domains is beneficial.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams, manage multiple requisitions, and meet hiring timelines.
* Proficiency with applicant tracking systems, HR databases, and standard office productivity tools is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.

 **Associate \- Placements**

 .

title: HRIS Analyst - Oracle Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
 The HRIS Analyst \- Oracle Specialist will serve as a functional subject matter expert (SME) for the Oracle Human Resources Management System (HRMS) / Oracle Fusion HCM platform, with primary responsibility for the configuration, optimization, support, and expansion of HR technology capabilities across a multinational operating environment. This role will lead the design, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of Oracle HRMS solutions and act as a key partner to HR, IT, Payroll, and business stakeholders. The ideal candidate brings deep, hands\-on Oracle HRMS expertise and a strong track record supporting global HR processes across Core HR, Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), Compensation, Benefits, Talent Management, Oracle Time and Labor (OTL), and related modules.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Serve as the primary functional SME for Oracle Human Resources Management System (HRMS)/Oracle Fusion HCM and provide day\-to\-day support, configuration, enhancement, and optimization across key HR modules.
* Lead system design, configuration, testing, implementation, troubleshooting, and production support activities for Oracle HRMS in a multinational environment.
* Partner with HR, Payroll, IT, and business stakeholders to gather requirements, translate business needs into scalable Oracle HRMS solutions, and recommend best\-practice system designs.
* Support and optimize Oracle HRMS modules, including Core HR, Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), Compensation, Benefits, Talent Management, and Oracle Time and Labor (OTL).
* Research, configure, and document solutions that address global business requirements, local country requirements, and process standardization opportunities.
* Coordinate and support system upgrades, patches, releases, and enhancements, including impact assessments, test strategy, regression testing, user acceptance testing, and deployment readiness.
* Maintain system configuration, tables, security roles, workflow setup, and related controls to ensure system reliability, usability, and compliance.
* Develop, validate, and support reports, dashboards, and analytics that enable HR decision\-making and improve operational visibility.
* Ensure data integrity through audits, controls, interface monitoring, issue resolution, and process improvements.
* Train and support end users, HR Business Partners, and other stakeholders on reporting, system functionality, and process changes.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, improve user experience, and strengthen HR operational effectiveness through Oracle HRMS.


**What You Will Need**
 Education and Experience
   

  

* BA/BS in MIS, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
* Strong hands\-on functional expertise in Oracle Human Resources Management System (HRMS)/Oracle Fusion HCM required.
* Significant progressive HRIS experience, including hands\-on experience supporting Oracle HRMS/Fusion HCM.
* Demonstrated experience with Oracle HRMS/Fusion HCM configuration, enhancements, implementations, testing, and production support required.
* Experience supporting global or multinational HR operations and country\-specific process requirements preferred.
* Experience supporting HR and/or Payroll systems, self\-service platforms, and related integrations preferred.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**
* Deep functional expertise in Oracle HRMS/Fusion HCM configuration, workflows, security, testing, troubleshooting, system maintenance, upgrades, and release support.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle HRMS business processes across Core HR, recruiting, compensation, benefits, talent, time and labor, and payroll\-related workflows.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable, sustainable Oracle HRMS solutions with strong attention to process design and user impact.
* Experience supporting system implementations, upgrades, and large\-scale enhancements in a complex business environment.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and data validation skills, with the ability to identify root causes and resolve system and process issues effectively.
* Advanced reporting skills, including the ability to work with large data sets and complex Microsoft Excel functions; Power BI experience is a plus.
* Strong customer\-facing, consulting, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across HR, IT, Payroll, and business teams.
* Working knowledge of data governance, privacy, and control requirements related to HR data.
* Experience in a high\-volume, transactional environment preferred.
* Oracle HRMS/Fusion HCM reporting, dashboarding, and analytics experience preferred.
* Obtain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality \& Environmental Management System.


**Reporting Relationships**
 The incumbent reports to a Manager, Director, or Executive level position. This position does not have any direct reports.
   

  

**About Us**
 We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.
   

  

 ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting\-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever\-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity**
 ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non\-work\-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.
   

  

**Notice**
 ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third\-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

title: Senior Specialist, Payroll Implementation & Integration-1
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Specialist, Payroll Implementation \& Integration\-1
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 The Senior Specialist, Payroll Implementation \& Integration supports strategic payroll initiatives, including mergers and acquisitions (M\&A), P\&C Modernization programs, system implementations, and process improvement efforts. This role serves as a key execution resource responsible for coordinating testing activities, validating payroll and employee data, supporting implementation readiness, and assisting with solution deployments across payroll operations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 M\&A Integration Support
   

  

* Support payroll workstreams during mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and organizational restructures.
* Assist with payroll integration planning and execution activities.
* Coordinate employee data collection, validation, and migration activities.
* Prepare implementation documentation and integration trackers.
* Support payroll readiness assessments and integration milestones.
* Monitor project tasks, risks, issues, and action items.
* Assist in stabilization activities following acquisitions.


 P\&C Modernization Implementation Support
   

  

* Participate in payroll\-related activities supporting Workday and P\&C Modernization initiatives.
* Support configuration validation and business process testing.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to evaluate payroll impacts of system changes.
* Coordinate payroll requirements gathering and documentation.
* Support process redesign and standardization initiatives.


 Testing \& Quality Assurance
   

  

* Execute end\-to\-end payroll testing activities for system implementations and enhancements.
* Develop and assist with unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), parallel payroll testing, regression testing
* Validate payroll calculations and outputs.
* Reconcile testing results and identify variances.
* Document, track, and help resolve defects.
* Verify successful implementation of payroll requirements.


 Process Improvement \& Documentation
   

  

* Create and maintain standard test scripts, process documentation, standard operating procedures
* Identify opportunities to improve payroll processes and implementation methodologies.
* Contribute to payroll implementation playbooks and best practices.
* Support operational readiness reviews.


 Vendor \& Stakeholder Coordination
   

  

* Collaborate with Payroll Operations, P\&C teams, Benefits, Technology teams, Third\-party payroll providers
* Participate in project meetings and provide implementation status updates.
* Escalate risks, issues, and testing concerns as necessary.
* Support communication and change management activities.


 Post\-Go\-Live Stabilization
   

  

* Assist with issue resolution following implementations.
* Monitor payroll processing and implementation outcomes.
* Validate corrective actions and system fixes.
* Transition completed solutions to operational payroll teams.


**Qualifications**
* 3–5 years of payroll, payroll implementation, or payroll operations experience.
* Experience supporting payroll system implementations or upgrades.
* Understanding of payroll processes, controls, and compliance requirements.
* Experience with testing methodologies and issue management.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Advanced Excel and data analysis capabilities.
* Experience supporting M\&A integrations.
* Experience with Workday, ADP, or other payroll platforms.
* Experience participating in large\-scale HR or payroll transformation programs.
* Knowledge of payroll compliance, tax, benefits, and time management processes.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: HRIS Analyst
description:
The HRIS Support Specialist provides operational support for the organization’s global HR systems, primarily Workday, UKG and Workforce. This temporary role is responsible for Tier 1 ticket handling (Ivanti and Workday “Request” tickets), reporting, audits, Workday security troubleshooting, global support activities, and extensive process documentation. This position requires proven experience supporting multiple countries and a high level of Workday Security knowledge. Strong communication skills, global customer service experience, and a high degree of accuracy are essential.

* Serve as the first point of contact for: o Ivanti HRIS tickets o Workday “Request” tickets
* Provide Tier 1 support for Workday and Workforce (navigation, data entry, troubleshooting).
* Triage and escalate complex issues based on established HRIS processes.
* Support end\-users across multiple regions and time zones within a global HR operating model.


**Ticket Analysis \& Knowledge Management**
* Track weekly ticket volume, types, trends, and resolutions across all countries supported.
* Analyze ticket patterns to identify recurring issues, training needs, and knowledge gaps.
* Produce insights and recommendations to reduce repeat issues.
* Create high\-quality documentation, job aids, and solutions that can be added to an internal knowledge base library.

**Workday Security Support**

* Validate access\-related requests and route complex issues appropriately.
* Document recurring security issues to support future process improvements. HR Data Quality \& Auditing

* Identify and document data discrepancies and partner with HR to correct issues.
* Maintain logs and documentation of audit results and follow\-up actions.


**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Run, validate, and distribute scheduled Workday reports.
* Build and maintain simple to intermediate\-level reports in Workday Report Writer.
* Support ad\-hoc reporting needs from global HR and business partners.


**HR Transactions \& Data Uploads**
* Prepare templates and execute routine EIB data uploads in Workday.
* Validate upload results and maintain detailed tracking and documentation. Process Documentation (Focus Area)
* Create, update, and maintain SOPs, process maps, and workflow documentation across all HRIS processes.
* Document procedures for handling tickets, audits, reports, EIB uploads, and recurring tasks.
* Develop user\-friendly guides and reference materials for HR partners globally.
* Ensure documentation is always accurate, standardized, and up to date.


**Testing \& Release Support**
* Assist with Workday bi\-annual release testing (UAT), including test cases, tracking results, and retesting.
* Support communication and training efforts for global system enhancements.


**General Administrative Support**
* Maintain logs and trackers for tickets, audits, documentation updates, and recurring tasks.
* Provide timely and professional communication to HR and business partners worldwide.
* Perform additional HRIS operational duties as assigned. Knowledge,


**Experience \& Skills Required Qualifications**
* 2–3 years of Workday experience in HR operations, HRIS support, or shared services.
* Proven experience supporting multiple countries and global HR teams.
* Strong, demonstrated Workday Security knowledge (roles, access troubleshooting, security groups).
* Experience creating and maintaining intermediate and complex Workday reports.
* Strong English communication skills (written and spoken).
* Excellent attention to detail, especially in data and documentation.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, global environment.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Workforce Time \& Attendance systems.
* Experience using Ivanti or similar ticketing platforms.
* Experience performing Workday EIB uploads.
* Previous experience developing SOPs or knowledge base documentation.
* Experience in global HR or shared services environments.

title: HR Generalist
description:
**Role Objective**
 To build and strengthen the people environment of the organization by bringing together talent, employee experience, development, retention, and people governance.
   

  

**What This Role Will Do**
* Own the employee lifecycle from hiring and onboarding through development, progression, retention, and exit, ensuring continuity across every stage of the employee experience.
* Build and continuously improve onboarding and orientation practices that help employees understand their role, team, organization, culture, and expectations from the beginning.
* Develop a strong understanding of the organization's people, working styles, team dynamics, capabilities, and evolving employee expectations through regular interaction and observation.
* Establish meaningful employee touchpoints and use insights from these interactions to identify concerns, patterns, capability gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Work with managers to address employee and team\-level challenges with practical, balanced HR intervention rather than relying solely on policy or process.
* Identify patterns in performance, engagement, attrition, capability, and team dynamics and translate them into actionable people priorities.
* Strengthen retention through a deeper understanding of employee aspirations, career expectations, managerial practices, role design, and organizational factors influencing retention.
* Own recruitment pipelines for current and anticipated hiring needs, ensuring the organization maintains a ready and relevant pool of talent rather than beginning sourcing only when a vacancy arises.
* Track pipeline health, candidate availability, conversion, hiring timelines, and recurring hiring patterns to identify recruitment risks and improve hiring predictability.
* Lead Talent Acquisition with a focus on quality of hire, assessment judgment, candidate experience, talent pipelines, and alignment with long\-term organizational needs.
* Build and improve HR frameworks, practices, and documentation that bring greater consistency and clarity to people decisions without creating unnecessary process.
* Stay current with employment practices, statutory requirements, compensation trends, talent\-market movements, and evolving HR practices, translating relevant developments into practical organizational action.
* Take ownership of identified people gaps from diagnosis through implementation, ensuring that HR interventions are followed through rather than remaining as recommendations.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of hands\-on HR experience with exposure across Talent Acquisition and people processes.
* Should have a master's degree in Management or Organizational Behaviour.
* Strong understanding of HR fundamentals, employment practices, and applicable statutory requirements.
* Practical awareness of talent\-market conditions, compensation practices, hiring benchmarks, retention considerations, and evolving workplace expectations.
* Strong recruitment capability, including proactive sourcing, talent mapping, pipeline development, candidate assessment, and stakeholder coordination.
* Strong observation and people\-understanding skills, with the ability to identify patterns that may not be immediately visible through formal feedback mechanisms.
* Strong communication, listening, and counseling ability, with the confidence to engage directly with employees, managers, and leadership on people matters.
* Sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive employee and organizational matters.
* High ownership and initiative; able to identify gaps, take action, and carry matters through to closure without constant direction.
* Ability to work with ambiguity, changing priorities, and cross\-functional stakeholders while maintaining clarity of thought and execution.
* Ability to understand business context and translate it into practical people priorities and HR interventions.

title: Manager - HR
description:
Manager, HR Reporting \& Analytics
   

  

**Function** 
 Human Resources / People Operations
   

  

**Reports to** 
 Head of HRIS
   

  

**Core systems** 
 Workday (HCM), Microsoft Fabric (data and analytics platform), ServiceNow HRSD (HR case management), Unifai (HR chatbot); expanding to benefits, rewards, and other HR platforms
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are hiring a Manager, HR Reporting \& Analytics to own the reporting and analytics that HR leaders, business partners, and finance rely on to make decisions.
   

  

 The role spans five areas: recurring and ad hoc reporting, analytics that answer questions leadership has not yet thought to ask, operational reporting for HR service delivery, the data accuracy and governance work that makes those answers trustworthy, and cyclical HR projects such as year\-end compensation. You will work primarily in Workday and Microsoft Fabric today, and will help extend the reporting layer as we bring ServiceNow, Unifai, benefits, and rewards data into the same environment.
   

  

 Reporting here is deliberately not Workday\-only. The HR service delivery teams run on ServiceNow for case management and on Unifai as the employee\-facing chatbot, and both need proper SLA and performance reporting. Bringing that operational data together with Workday people data in Fabric is a core part of the job, not a side project.
   

  

 The person who succeeds here is equally comfortable writing a Workday report, building an SLA dashboard from case data, tracing a headcount discrepancy back to a bad transaction, and explaining to a business leader why last month’s number changed.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 Reporting
   

  

* Own the HR reporting calendar across systems: headcount, turnover and attrition, hiring and requisition status, movement and promotion, diversity representation, absence, workforce cost, and HR service delivery performance.
* Build and maintain Workday reports, calculated fields, and dashboards; retire and consolidate redundant reports rather than letting the inventory grow unchecked.
* Deliver executive\-ready reporting for the HR leadership team, business unit leaders, and finance, including board and audit requests.
* Handle ad hoc data requests with a fast turnaround, and convert the ones that keep coming back into self\-service reports or dashboards.
* Produce reporting required for regulatory, statutory, and audit purposes, and stand behind the numbers when they are challenged.


 Analytics and insight
   

  

* Move beyond descriptive reporting: identify trends, segment drivers, and outliers in workforce data, and explain what they mean for the business.
* Partner with the development team to build and maintain semantic models, datasets, and dashboards in Microsoft Fabric that combine Workday data with data from other HR and business systems.
* Partner with HRBPs and COEs to frame business questions into answerable analyses, and to translate findings into recommendations leaders can act on.
* Support workforce planning, span\-of\-control and organisational design analysis, and cost modelling in partnership with finance.
* Develop a small set of trusted, defined HR metrics and hold the line on their definitions so that numbers reconcile across audiences.


 HR service delivery reporting (ServiceNow and Unifai)
   

  

* Build and own SLA and performance reporting for the HR service delivery teams working in ServiceNow HRSD: case volume by category and tier, first response and resolution time against SLA, SLA attainment and breach analysis, backlog and aging, reassignment and escalation rates, reopen rates, and case CSAT.
* Report on Unifai chatbot performance: session and query volume, intent recognition and match rates, containment and deflection rate, hand\-off and escalation into ServiceNow cases, unresolved or unrecognised intents, and satisfaction.
* Connect the two: report on the end\-to\-end employee journey from chatbot query through case creation to resolution, so that deflection and case volume are read together rather than in isolation.
* Surface where self\-service is failing. Use recurring case drivers, repeat contacts, and failed chatbot intents to recommend knowledge article, process, and content improvements, and measure whether those changes actually reduced contact volume.
* Provide the operational reporting HR service leaders need to manage capacity and staffing: volume seasonality, workload distribution, handle time, and productivity by team and region.
* Enrich service delivery data with Workday attributes such as location, business unit, job level, and tenure so that case and chatbot activity can be analysed by population, not just by ticket queue.
* Report against service delivery commitments used in governance forums and vendor or internal SLA reviews, and hold a consistent definition of how SLA clocks, business hours, and pauses are calculated.


 Data accuracy and management
   

  

* Own HR data quality: design and run recurring audits, reconciliation routines, and exception reports that surface errors before they reach a report or a paycheck.
* Investigate discrepancies to root cause, whether that is a data entry error, a business process gap, an integration failure, or a configuration issue, and drive the fix with the owning team.
* Maintain data definitions, business rules, and documentation for core HR data domains: worker, position, organisation, job, compensation, and location.
* Support data governance: field ownership, allowable values, required fields, and the change control process for definition changes.
* Enforce appropriate handling of sensitive HR data, including access controls, aggregation thresholds, and privacy requirements across jurisdictions.
* Reconcile HR data against downstream and adjacent systems (payroll, finance, benefits, identity and access) on a defined cadence.
* Extend data quality work beyond Workday: case categorisation accuracy and consistency in ServiceNow, intent tagging in Unifai, and the mappings that let service delivery data join cleanly to Workday worker and organisation data.


 Special projects and HR cycles
   

  

* Serve as the data and reporting lead for year\-end compensation: population and eligibility files, budget modelling, merit and bonus matrices, scenario and cost analysis, statement data, and post\-cycle audit and reconciliation.
* Support other cyclical processes with a heavy data component: performance and talent review calendars, benefits open enrolment, pay equity and gender pay gap analysis, and annual regulatory filings.
* Contribute to HR technology projects as the reporting and data subject matter expert: requirements, data mapping, test scenarios, cutover validation, and post\-go\-live reporting.
* Help extend the HR data footprint as new systems come online, including ServiceNow, Unifai, and benefits and rewards platforms, so that reporting keeps pace with the tooling.


 Scope
   

  

* Primary stakeholders: HR leadership team, HRBPs, HR Service Delivery / Shared Services, Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, and Internal Audit.
* No direct reports; expected to influence and coordinate across HR, IT, and finance without formal authority.
* Partners with HRIS and IT on configuration, integrations, and platform changes; owns the reporting and data quality layer that sits on top.

title: Head of Human Resources - Global Innovation Center
description:
**Job Description**
 Title:
 **Head of Human Resources – Global Innovation Center**
 We are looking for a Head of HR for our newly established Global Innovation Center (GIC) in Pune, India. You will be responsible for building, scaling, and running the full people strategy for the Jefferies GIC. In this role, you will play an important part in developing the talent, helping create the culture, and be deeply involved in governance, and the people operations framework needed to operate a high performing, innovation\-driven global center.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
*HR Strategy \& Organizational Build\-Out*
* Establish the HR operating model for the GIC, aligned with Jefferies’ global people strategy, and localized for the Pune labor market.
* Partner with the GIC leadership team to align HR priorities with delivery demands.
* Build and lead the end\-to\-end people lifecycle for the GIC including workforce planning, onboarding, performance management, compensation including benchmarking to local market, and management of employee relations in partnership with employment legal.
* Establish and continuously refine organization structures, role architecture, and capability frameworks that support scaled growth.


*Stakeholder Management \& Leadership*
* Serve as the primary HR business advisor to the GIC Head and global technology leaders.
* Partner closely with global HR leadership including Global Head of HR, Asia Head of HR, Corporate Head of HR and Global Head of Recruiting to ensure the GIC develops as a seamless extension of Jefferies’ global organizational model.
* Represent the GIC HR function in global forums, governance committees, and transformation programs.
* Provide development, training, guidance, and leadership to new GIC HR team members.
* Help identify and successfully hire the GIC HR team.


*Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning*
* Partner with recruiting leadership and global stakeholders to support the development and execution of a comprehensive hiring strategy. This will include contributing to superday hiring initiatives, advancing workforce diversity goals, and helping to define the technical requirements that enable the recruiting team to build a strong candidate pipeline aligned to the GIC’s strategic objectives.
* Ensure all hiring processes are consistent with Jefferies’ global standards and local regulatory requirements.
* In partnership with Head of Recruiting for GIC, drive leadership hiring and oversee recruitment governance, vendor management, and capacity planning.


*Culture, Engagement \& Local HR Policy*
* In partnership with Technology leaders, define the Jefferies culture of the GIC.
* Advise and partner closely with the India HR team across the two established Jefferies entities, and employment legal in establishing regulatory requirements such as India Labor codes and ensuring ongoing compliance.
* Localize global people policies, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and alignment to GIC local culture.
* Design and deliver employee engagement strategies, leadership development, inclusion initiatives, and communication programs to foster a cohesive, high performance GIC culture.


*Compensation, Performance \& Development*
* Establish performance management frameworks optimized for GIC talent.
* Lead compensation and benefits strategy for the GIC in partnership with Compensation \& Benefits team, driving alignment with the GIC market.
* Partner with the global Training \& Development and Community \& Engagement teams to design capability building programs.


*HR Governance \& Compliance*
* Ensure the GIC is audit ready across all HR processes, partnering with Global HR, Compliance, and Legal.
* Operationalize local employment requirements relevant to Pune.
* Lead engagement with external audits for items related to Pune and the GIC.


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 15\+ years of experience in financial services business advisory HR leadership, with experience leading HR for GICs, shared services, or global operations businesses.
* Proven experience in growth environments and building HR functions from the ground up.
* Extensive knowledge of the Pune talent market with strong local labor law and regulatory experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and matrix organization influencing skills; experience partnering with global functional heads.
* Proven track record in leadership and management of employment relations matters.
* Ability to thrive in an entrepreneurial, fast scaling, environment.
* Experience managing HR transformation and change\-management initiatives.


**About Us**
 Jefferies is a leading global, full\-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.
   

  

 At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.
   

  

 Jefferies is an equal employment opportunity employer, and takes affirmative action to ensure that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, or any other factor protected by applicable law. We are committed to hiring the most qualified applicants and complying with all federal, state, and local equal employment opportunity laws. As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
HEAD OF HUMAN RESOURCES
 



 Location: Pune, India
 



 Reporting To: Director / Principal
 



  





 About the Organisation
 



  





 A prestigious, privately held estate and hospitality group operating multiple luxury residential properties, managed farms, and allied establishments across India. The group is associated with one of India's most respected family offices and maintains the highest standards of service, discretion, and operational excellence across its portfolio.
 



  





 Role Overview
 



  





 We are seeking an experienced and commercially astute Head of Human Resources to lead and manage all people functions across the estate's multiple properties. This is a senior leadership role suited to an HR professional who thrives in a high\-standard, principal\-led environment and has the maturity to manage both strategic HR initiatives and day\-to\-day operational people matters across diverse verticals — including household, hospitality, and support services.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Develop and execute a people strategy aligned with the group's values and long\-term vision
 



 Oversee end\-to\-end HR operations across all properties, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, payroll coordination, and exit management
 



 Build and maintain staffing structures for multiple residences, farms, and operational teams; define role clarity, reporting lines, and manpower norms
 



 Establish and implement SOPs for HR processes across properties, ensuring consistency and compliance
 



 Lead talent acquisition for household, estate management, hospitality, and support functions; manage vendor and agency relationships for niche and specialist hiring

 Ensure full statutory compliance including PF, ESIC, Gratuity, Labour Law, Shops \& Establishments, and POSH across all locations
 



 Manage payroll inputs and coordinate with finance for accurate and timely disbursements
 



 Handle employee relations with tact and discretion; act as a trusted advisor to leadership on sensitive people matters
 



 Maintain strict confidentiality in all HR and personnel affairs in keeping with the private nature of the organisation
 



 Oversee HR MIS, reporting, and dashboards for leadership review
 



 Support succession planning and retention strategies for key roles
 



  





 Candidate Profile
 



  





 Minimum 12–15 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 3–5 years in a leadership capacity
 



 Prior experience in luxury hospitality, private estates, UHNW household management, or similar high\-standard environments strongly preferred
 



 Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws, statutory compliance, and payroll practices
 



 Hands\-on, detail\-oriented professional who is equally comfortable with strategy and execution
 



 Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; ability to manage staff at all levels with authority and empathy
 



 High degree of personal integrity, discretion, and professionalism
 



 Proficient in MS Office; familiarity with HRMS platforms is an advantage
 



 Willingness to travel across property locations as required
 



  





 What We Offer
 



  





 A rare opportunity to lead HR for a distinguished and well\-resourced private group
 



 Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
 



 A stable, long\-term engagement with a respected principal family

title: Consultant
description:
**Forward Deployed Consultant** 




**Future Fabric \| Organisation Design \& Talent Advisory** 




**Pune \| Work from Office** 




  





**Org. \& Talent Consultant** 
 who provides end\-to\-end solutions and support inside the client to bring about real change – especially in the areas of
 **Org. Design, Performance \& Talent Management, Rewards Design** 









**Why this role exists** 




 At People Equation, we believe the best consulting involves not only solutioning but stays close enough to see change happen.
 



 Our consultants work alongside leadership teams and HR functions inside the client's context, helping solve organisation and talent challenges from diagnosis through implementation. We combine strategic thinking with operational capabilities and remain engaged until solutions become part of the way the organisation works.
 



  





 We call this our
 **Forward\-Deployed Consulting** 
 model.
 



  





 Our work for clients spans four interconnected dimensions:
 


* **Org. Design \& Talent Solutions —** 
 Design organisation structures and operating models, workforce planning, build job and career architecture, design performance \& talent management processes, and rewards design.
* **Deployment \& Change —** 
 Help organisations deploy the solutions and adopt, embed and sustain change through practical implementation, stakeholder engagement and capability building.
* **HR Partnering \& Operations —** 
 Work alongside client business and HR teams (as a project / in fractional capacity) to ensure operational efficiencies, compliant functioning, and the right culture and employee experience.
* **Recruitment —** 
 Strengthen organisations through executive search and recruitment advisory that ensure right people are in the right roles.



  





**What you'll do** 




 You'll work directly with client leadership on organisation and talent challenges. Your core work:
 


* **Organisation \& Operating Model Design** 
 — structure, spans and layers, role charters, design options and trade\-offs; and how work, decisions and accountabilities flow across the organisation
* **Workforce Planning** 
 — demand and supply modelling, productivity, cost\-to\-serve, build / buy / borrow choices
* **Performance \& Talent Management** 
 – philosophy \& process design, performance scorecards, performance \& potential assessment, talent review
* **Job Architecture and Career Frameworks** 
 — job families, job levelling, career architecture
* **Rewards Design** 
 — grades and bands, benchmarking, incentive and variable pay structures



  





 You may also contribute across the wider practice:
 


* Leadership development, culture and change
* HR transformation and fractional HR services (including operations, compliance)
* Learning and development
* Executive search and mid\-level recruitment, as part of broader client solutions



 Apart from project work, you will support client accounts, help strengthen the assets / IP of the practice, and build capability in fellow consultants.
 



  





**Who we're looking for** 




 We're looking for consultants who enjoy solving business problems through people solutions. Typically, you'll bring:
 


* **4 \- 5 years of experience** 
 across HR consulting and HR COEs / business partnering
* Hands\-on project depth in organisation design, operating models, workforce planning, performance management, job architecture or compensation design.
* Practical exposure to HR operations and business partnering
* Working knowledge of executive search, recruitment or talent acquisition
* Strong facilitation, communication and structured problem\-solving skills
* Comfort with data — able to build and defend a model in Excel, and read market benchmarking well
* Intermediate or higher\-level skills in AI and the ability to leverage it to improve impact



  





**Success looks like** 




 Within your first year, you'll have:
 


* Led organisation design or workforce planning workstreams from diagnosis through implementation
* Delivered design artefacts clients actually adopt — structures, scorecards, architecture, pay frameworks
* Become a trusted advisor to multiple client leaders
* Delivered measurable business and people outcomes
* Contributed to People Equation's consulting IP and AI\-enabled ways of working
* Built lasting client relationships that lead to repeat opportunities



  





**What this role is not** 




 This isn't a strategy\-only consulting role, nor is it purely an HRBP, L\&D or recruitment role.
 



 It's for consultants who enjoy staying close to clients, solving real organisational problems through advisory \& services, and creating lasting change.
 








**The details** 




**Location:** 
 Pune, work from office (with reasonable flexibility)
 



**Career Level:** 
 Consultant, reporting to Partner
 



**Contact:** 
 If you are interested, write to
 
 yajna.d@peopleequation.io
 




  





  





**People Equation**
 is a boutique advisory firm specializing in Organization \& Talent, Applied AI, and GCCs and helping organizations thrive in the age of AI.

 Skill in instructional design of training and development content
   

  

 Excellent facilitation and presentation skills for training and development programs
   

  

 Strong data analysis skills with the ability to interpret and act on HR metrics and KPIs
   

  

 Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with ability to enhance collaboration
   

  

 Strong analytical skills and experience with talent management data measurement and reporting
   

  

 Technical proficiency with HRIS and talent management systems
   

  

 Experience managing vendor contracts and relationships
   

  

 Ability and desire to innovate to discover and implement AI for business process improvement

We will work together, learn together and have fun together. As a team, we will lead HMH’s digital transformation.
