title: Payroll Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**
* Serve as a liaison between Payroll Operations and business unit customers, partnering with Human Resources, employees, internal departments, and external vendors to understand requirements and support business needs.
* Track and support the resolution of payroll issues and operational risks that are critical to payroll production and service delivery.
* Process payroll adjustments, including balance corrections, earnings updates, hours adjustments, and other payroll\-related corrections.
* Provide primary support to users and resolve inquiries related to payroll processes and employee self\-service tools.
* Support employee transfers across Emerson businesses and legal entities.
* Identify, document, and escalate unresolved system or process errors that impact productivity or employee experience.
* Perform regression testing for recurring payroll system patches and updates using assigned test scripts.
* Ensure accurate and timely payroll processing and payments across multiple pay frequencies, locations, and legal entities.
* Complete core payroll activities, including balance adjustments, mass salary updates, emergency payments, and recurring payroll processes.
* Participate in ongoing training and development to maintain payroll and system expertise.
* Utilize payroll and supporting software tools to ensure accurate data management and processing.
* Support benefits\-related payroll activities, including healthcare contributions, gratuity, superannuation, National Pension System (NPS) contributions, pension\-related information, and other employee benefit deductions.
* Maintain payroll data integrity, confidentiality, and compliance with data privacy requirements.
* Update employee records and coordinate with external parties regarding expat and international commuter payroll activities.
* Provide timely responses and documentation through HR support channels, including Contact HR systems, email requests, and phone inquiries.
* Research applicable laws, regulations, and payroll requirements as needed.
* Follow up with customers and team members to ensure timely and accurate resolution of requests.
* Import and reconcile time entry files as part of payroll processing activities.
* Provide backup support for departmental administrative tasks, including mail processing, garnishment uploads, tax notice ticket creation, and related activities.
* Support additional responsibilities and projects as assigned by leadership.
* Manage payroll tax and statutory compliance activities, including Provident Fund (PF), Employees’ State Insurance Corporation (ESIC), Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund (LWF), Income Tax, Tax Deducted at Source (TDS), pension contributions, retirement benefits, and other regulatory requirements.
* Prepare payroll reports, payroll accruals, provisions, and payroll\-related information required by Finance.
* Support payroll\-related projects, including payroll mergers, bulk legal entity transfers, and annual compensation planning and execution activities.
* Coordinate internal and external payroll audits, inspections, and compliance reviews, ensuring accurate documentation and timely submission of required information.
* Manage Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) and performance share taxation processes and address employee tax\-related inquiries.
* Provide payroll support and guidance to employees at all organizational levels, ensuring timely and accurate issue resolution.
* Assist former employees with taxation\-related matters and support international employee transfer cases.
* Provide payroll and tax information to external vendors supporting tax equalization programs.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives through process documentation, control enhancement, operational efficiency improvements, knowledge sharing, and customer experience optimization.


**Who You Are:**
 You adjust communication to fit the audience and the message and establish and maintain customer relationships. You learn from new experiences, others, and structured learning opportunities, and you display a positive, action\-oriented approach in both routine and challenging situations. You take time to ask questions, define problems, and make learning a priority while continuously seeking ways to improve outcomes and deliver value.
   

  

**For This Role, You Will Need:**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Payroll, Business, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.
* Experience supporting payroll operations in a complex, multi\-business, multi\-location, or shared services environment.
* Knowledge of payroll processing, payroll taxation, statutory compliance, and payroll\-related employee support activities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, and other business productivity tools.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact effectively across all organizational levels.
* Knowledge of payroll tax regulations and payroll configuration concepts to support accurate employee taxation.
* Strong prioritization skills with the ability to recognize urgency and manage competing priorities.
* Flexibility and adaptability in a changing business environment.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced operational setting.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with a focus on identifying root causes and preventing recurring issues.
* High attention to detail and commitment to maintaining confidentiality of sensitive employee and payroll information.
* Ability to understand end\-to\-end processes and make sound decisions when detailed guidance may not always be available.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities while maintaining accuracy and quality.


**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**
* Approximately 5 to 7 years of payroll, HR operations, shared services, or related experience.
* Experience working with Oracle applications or enterprise payroll and HR systems.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, reporting, analytics, and data management.
* Experience supporting payroll compliance, audits, employee mobility, tax equalization, or stock\-based compensation taxation processes.
* Familiarity with global payroll operations and continuous improvement methodologies.


**Our Culture and Commitment To You:**
 At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
   

  

 At Emerson, we are committed to fostering a culture of integrity, safety, quality, innovation, and continuous learning. We value diverse perspectives and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. We recognize that skills and experiences can be gained through different paths and welcome candidates who can contribute to the success of our teams and customers. By joining Emerson, you will be part of a collaborative global organization dedicated to solving complex challenges and creating sustainable value for our customers, communities, and employees.
   

  

**About Us**
**WHY EMERSON**
**Our Commitment to Our People**
 At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.
   

  

 We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award\-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.
   

  

 At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.

 Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability.
   

  

 With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety.
   

  

 We offer equitable opportunities, celebrate diversity, and embrace challenges with confidence that, together, we can make an impact across a broad spectrum of countries and industries. Whether you’re an established professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring possibilities, or a recent graduate with an advanced degree, you’ll find your chance to make a difference with Emerson. Join our team – let’s go!

description:
**About Us**
 At Ugaoo, we’ve always believed plants are more than décor, they’re companions, healers, and reminders of what truly matters. What began as a small idea sparked by a plant on a windowsill has grown into India’s leading gardening brand, backed by marquee investors like DSG Consumer Partners and V3 Ventures. From our 25\-acre farm in Talegaon to a thriving D2C store and retail presence across Pune, Mumbai, Delhi and
   

  

 Bangaluru, we’re building an ecosystem that brings nature closer to homes, offices, and communities.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a detail\-oriented and process\-driven Executive \- Payroll \& Compliances to manage day\-to\-day payroll activities and support statutory compliance while ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to all applicable regulations. This role will be responsible for managing payroll inputs, processing monthly payroll, supporting statutory filings, maintaining employee records, coordinating with Finance and HR Operations, and ensuring timely closure of payroll and compliance activities. The ideal candidate brings a good understanding of Indian payroll, taxation, statutory requirements, and HRMS systems, along with strong attention to detail and the ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Payroll Management
   

  

* Manage and validate monthly payroll inputs including attendance, leave, new joiners, exits, salary revisions, deductions, reimbursements, and variable pay.
* Process monthly payroll through HRMS, preferably Keka, ensuring accuracy and timely closure.
* Support payroll processing for a large and diverse workforce across blue\-collar and white\-collar categories.
* Prepare and validate salary structures, deductions, reimbursements, and variable pay inputs.
* Process full \& final settlements for exiting employees and ensure timely closure of payroll\-related documentation.
* Coordinate with HR Operations to ensure accurate employee lifecycle data including onboarding, confirmations, attendance, leave records, exits, and documentation.
* Coordinate with Finance for payroll inputs, deductions, reconciliations, salary disbursement, and payroll\-related queries.
* Perform payroll checks and reconciliations to identify and resolve discrepancies before payroll closure.
* Maintain accurate and confidential employee payroll records in the HRMS.
* Support the preparation of HR letters, payroll reports, and other payroll\-related documentation.


 Compliance \& Statutory Requirements
   

  

* Prepare and maintain data required for monthly and periodic statutory compliances including PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, and TDS.
* Support timely statutory filings and ensure required employee and payroll data is accurate and complete.
* Maintain statutory registers, employee records, compliance trackers, licenses, and related documentation.
* Track statutory deadlines and follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely completion of compliance activities.
* Coordinate with external consultants for statutory filings, reconciliations, and compliance requirements.
* Support audits, inspections, and queries from consultants, auditors, and regulatory authorities.
* Support compliance activities related to Trade Licenses, Shops \& Establishments requirements, Fire NOCs, and other applicable registrations.
* Stay updated on relevant payroll and statutory changes and highlight any required actions to the Manager.


 Reporting \& Analytics
   

  

* Prepare monthly payroll MIS reports and compliance trackers for management review.
* Prepare headcount, payroll cost, deductions, and statutory liability reports.
* Reconcile payroll data with Finance records and identify discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate payroll and compliance dashboards and reports.
* Provide payroll data and documentation required for audits and internal reviews.
* Identify recurring payroll issues and support improvements in payroll processes and controls.


**What You'll Bring**
* 2 to 5 years of experience in payroll, HR operations, and statutory compliance.
* Experience in managing day\-to\-day payroll activities for a large employee population, preferably across blue\-collar and white\-collar workforce.
* Good understanding of Indian payroll practices, income tax, PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, TDS, and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Experience working with HRMS or payroll systems, preferably Keka.
* Good knowledge of Excel and experience working with payroll reports and reconciliations.
* Understanding of salary structures, payroll inputs, full \& final settlements, statutory filings, and compliance documentation.
* Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and time management.
* Good coordination and communication skills with the ability to work closely with HR and Finance teams.
* Strong sense of ownership, confidentiality, and process discipline.
* A team player with a positive attitude and the ability to thrive in a dynamic startup environment.
* Join us, and help shape the future of gardening and grow with us, because Plants Grow People.


***Join us, and help shape the future of gardening and grow with us, because Plants Grow People.***

description:
Job description:
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Responsible for managing and strengthening Compensation \& Benefits across Asia,
 **covering Southeast Asia (Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Philippines and Vietnam), Japan, South Korea, India and Australia,** 
 by ensuring programs, processes and practices are market\-relevant, compliant, performance\-oriented and aligned with global reward principles
   

  

**As part of the Global CoE Compensation and Benefits, you will act as the regional C\&B subject matter expert, providing practical advice, market insights and governance support to country HR, business leaders and relevant stakeholders across the region.**
 This role plays a key role in shaping and leading C\&B\-related change by developing and implementing reward concepts, frameworks, governance models, systems, job architecture initiatives and process improvements across countries and entities, with alignment to regional and global C\&B priorities.
   

  

**Job Scope**
**Compensation \& Benefits Management**
* Lead Compensation \& Benefits activities across Asia, ensuring programs and practices are competitive, compliant and aligned with global reward principles.
* Support the development, review and maintenance of salary structures, bonus arrangements, benefits programs, job leveling and related C\&B frameworks.
* Ensure regional C\&B practices are applied consistently while allowing for appropriate local adaptation based on market conditions, business needs and legal requirements.


**Annual Salary Review Governance**
* Manage the annual salary review process across countries and entities, including budget preparation, process coordination, governance, stakeholder alignment and execution.
* Work with country HR and business leaders to ensure salary review decisions are supported by performance, market competitiveness, internal fairness and budget discipline.
* Strengthen C\&B governance by maintaining clear processes, documentation, decision principles and escalation routes, including for joint venture or country\-specific requirements.


**Market Intelligence \& Benchmarking**
* Conduct market benchmarking and compensation analysis to support salary ranges, pay positioning, benefits decisions and reward recommendations.
* Provide country\-level market insights to identify competitiveness gaps, retention risks and areas requiring management attention.
* Use data and analysis to support exception cases where business justification, market evidence and cost alignment are required.


**Reward Program Design \& Transformation**
* Lead or support the design and improvement of global reward programs, including bonus structures, incentives, benefits and related C\&B policies or guidelines.
* Review local benefits and allowances to ensure they remain relevant, competitive, sustainable and aligned with local practices.
* Lead or contribute to C\&B\-related change initiatives, including governance improvements, HR Hub support, grading and job architecture projects, digitalization, and system or process changes across Asia.
* Drive adoption of new or updated C\&B frameworks through clear communication, stakeholder alignment, training and follow\-up.


**Stakeholder Advisory \& Collaboration**
* Act as a trusted advisor to HR, managers and business leaders on compensation and benefits matters.
* Provide clear guidance and recommendations using market data, analysis and sound C\&B judgement.
* Collaborate with country HR, Finance, Payroll, Legal, global C\&B colleagues and other relevant stakeholders to ensure effective implementation of C\&B programs, processes and decisions.
* Develop communication materials and training to improve understanding of reward principles, processes and programs across different countries and stakeholder levels.


**Job Requirements**
* BSc in Human Resources, Business, Finance or related discipline; other disciplines may be considered with relevant experience
* At least 5\+ years of professional compensation \& benefits experience with both strategic and operational scope across multiple Asian markets
* Proven ability to shape, develop and implement Compensation \& Benefits concepts with regional and global scope
* Proven experience leading change efforts in a regional or matrix environment, including implementation of new frameworks, governance models, programs, systems, or processes
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into clear business recommendations
* Strong stakeholder management through collaboration and negotiation and the ability to influence and advise in a matrix and multicultural environment
* Ability to balance global consistency with local flexibility and commercial realities
* Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to train and advise managers and HR teams
* Fluent in written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently with regional and global stakeholders
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Advanced Excel and PowerPoint; experience with data analytics tools and HR systems such as SuccessFactors is advantageous

title: Senior HR Analyst
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior HR Analyst
   

  

**About The Role**
 The People Analyst will be a key member of the Regional People Data \& Analytics team, delivering workforce insights, analytics, and strategic decision support across multiple business units globally. This role combines analytics, data management, reporting, program management, and emerging AI capabilities to enable data\-driven talent decisions across Mastercard.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a detail\-oriented problem solver with strong SQL and data modeling expertise, a passion for data quality, and an interest in leveraging Generative AI to improve workforce analytics and business outcomes. This individual will help transform complex people data into actionable insights while driving consistency, scalability, and innovation across reporting and analytics solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Workforce Analytics \& Reporting
   

  

 Serve as the primary point of contact for operational reporting, workforce metrics, and analytics requests from global stakeholders.
   

  

 Partner with business leaders to understand underlying business challenges and translate them into actionable analytical solutions.
   

  

 Collaborate with the Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A) CoE to support monthly headcount reporting, forecasting, and workforce analysis.
   

  

 Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations that provide meaningful workforce insights.
   

  

 Data Management \& Quality
   

  

 Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of workforce data across systems and reporting solutions.
   

  

 Partner with HR Systems, Data Management, and Engineering teams to identify and resolve data quality issues.
   

  

 Establish controls and validation processes to improve trust and reliability of workforce metrics.
   

  

 Drive data governance standards and ensure compliance with privacy and security requirements for people data.
   

  

 Data Modeling \& Analytics Engineering
   

  

 Design and maintain scalable analytical data models to support reporting, self\-service analytics, AI use cases, and workforce planning.
   

  

 Apply dimensional modeling principles and create efficient data structures for workforce analytics.
   

  

 Leverage SQL to query, analyze, validate, and optimize large and complex datasets.
   

  

 Collaborate with Data Engineers and Analysts to improve analytical data foundations and reporting capabilities.
   

  

 AI \& Innovation
   

  

 Explore and leverage Generative AI solutions to improve reporting efficiency, automate insights generation, and enhance workforce analytics.
   

  

 Identify opportunities to incorporate AI\-driven capabilities into reporting, analytics, and decision support processes.
   

  

 Partner with analytics teams to evaluate emerging technologies and improve the employee analytics experience.
   

  

**All About You**
 Essential Qualifications
   

  

 Experience working with organizational, workforce, HR, or people\-related data.
   

  

 Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes behind business questions.
   

  

 Advanced SQL skills with experience querying, analyzing, troubleshooting, and optimizing large datasets.
   

  

 Strong understanding of data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling, relationships, keys, hierarchies, and analytical data structures.
   

  

 Proven ability to improve data quality, data integrity, and reporting accuracy across multiple systems and data sources.
   

  

 Advanced Excel experience including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, formulas, conditional formatting, charts, and data analysis.
   

  

 Ability to communicate complex analytical findings to non\-technical audiences.
   

  

 Experience building scalable reporting solutions, dashboards, and self\-service analytics capabilities.
   

  

 Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively across global teams and multiple time zones.
   

  

 Ability to work within data governance, privacy, and compliance frameworks.
   

  

 Flexible, proactive, and able to adapt to changing business priorities.
   

  

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Experience with HRIS platforms, preferably Workday.
   

  

 Experience managing and analyzing structured and unstructured data using SQL, Python, R, or similar technologies.
   

  

 Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Domo, or similar platforms.
   

  

 Familiarity with ETL and data integration tools such as Alteryx, Informatica, or similar technologies.
   

  

 Exposure to Generative AI technologies and AI\-powered analytics solutions.
   

  

 Experience designing analytical datasets, semantic layers, feature stores, or enterprise reporting models.
   

  

 Understanding of data governance, metadata management, and enterprise data quality frameworks.
   

  

 Experience influencing stakeholders and driving adoption across large, matrixed organizations.
   

  

 Knowledge of workforce planning, talent analytics, organizational effectiveness, or employee experience analytics.
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Associate Director - Global Talent Operations
description:
**Job Description**
**Associate Director, Global Talent Operations**
 Location: Pune, India (global role) \| Reports to: Global Head of People / CHRO \| Experience: 12 to 20 years \| Type: Full time
   

  

**About The Role**
 Anchanto is a global enterprise grade B2B SaaS company. We provide cloud software for brands, retailers, and logistics providers to manage orders, warehouses, inventory, marketplaces, and omnichannel commerce. We operate across 12 countries, support more than 300 enterprise and mid\-market customers, and process over 150 million commerce transactions a year.
   

  

 As Anchanto scales, the People function has to run with the same reliability, speed, and discipline we expect from our own platforms. This role builds and runs that execution engine. Internally, think of this as the operational backbone of the People function. The CHRO owns people strategy and transformation. HRBPs own business partnership and performance. Talent Acquisition owns hiring. This role owns execution reliability across the Anchanter lifecycle. The expectation is operational excellence, not administrative processing.
   

  

 This is a build and scale mandate. You start with a small team and are expected to grow the function and its capability as Anchanto grows. It is not a maintenance seat.
   

  

**One Anchanter experience for all 300 \+ Anchanters across 19 nationalities, everywhere. From Korea to France and every country in between, the operational experience an Anchanter receives should be consistent, reliable, and enterprise grade.** 
 Making that true across all 12 countries is this role's responsibility. This is operational consistency in onboarding, lifecycle, support, systems, and service levels. It is not cultural uniformity, which sits with other parts of the People function.
   

  

**Why This Role Exists**
 Today, too much people work runs on manual effort, inconsistencies and spreadsheets, and too much of it lands on HRBPs and leaders. This role exists to fix that. The mission is to build a Talent Operations function that is trusted, scalable, data driven, AI enabled, compliant, and enterprise grade, so that HRBPs and leadership can focus on organisation effectiveness, leadership, and growth.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
 The role owns eight areas. The list is deliberately broad because this is the function owner, but the bar is the same throughout: systems and data over manual effort, clear ownership, and reliable execution for every Anchanter.
   

  

* Global Anchanter lifecycle operations


 Run enterprise grade lifecycle operations across geographies: onboarding and induction, employment documentation and contract governance, confirmation and probation, internal mobility and transfers, promotion and status changes, records integrity, exit and offboarding, and asset and access recovery. Identify recurring pain points and bottlenecks proactively and fix them at the root. Outcome: smooth transitions, fast and consistent turnaround, no operational ambiguity.
   

  

* Payroll inputs, benefits, and compliance operations


 Payroll is run by an external provider. This role owns the inputs to that provider and the operational integrity around them, not the payroll run or filing itself. That means accurate and on time payroll inputs across countries, benefits administration, leave and attendance, insurance and claims, coordination with the payroll provider and country partners, and audit readiness on the input side. Outcome: payroll inputs are clean and on time every cycle, the provider has exactly what it needs, and compliance risk is managed before it surfaces.
   

  

* HR systems and talent technology


 Own and modernise the People technology stack: HRMS, ATS and hiring workflows, integrations, access and permissions, workflow automation, data governance, and self\-service. People Operations should run through systems, not spreadsheets. You also own the operational vendor relationships that sit underneath this, including HRMS, the payroll provider, insurance, background verification, and engagement platforms, holding them to service levels and value. Outcome: reduced manual dependency, a clean and trusted system of record, and vendors that deliver.
   

  

* People analytics and workforce intelligence


 Operate people data as a decision system, not an activity report. Build workforce and headcount dashboards, attrition and retention analysis, hiring and funnel reporting, workforce cost visibility, and early warning indicators. Leadership reporting should answer where workforce risk is emerging, where managers are struggling, where hiring is stuck, which attrition patterns matter, and which cost trends need intervention.
   

  

* Anchanter experience and service delivery


 Deliver an enterprise grade operational experience across every touchpoint: onboarding, lifecycle transitions, support interactions, communication workflows, and exits. Run Anchanter query and support management to a high standard of responsiveness, professionalism, ownership, and service orientation, with clear SLAs, defined escalation paths, and accountable resolution. Communicate policy clearly so Anchanters know where they stand, and keep simplifying process so the experience improves over time. Anchanters should experience clarity, responsiveness, professionalism, and reliability.
   

  

* Policy governance and risk management


 Create operational trust through governance: policy lifecycle and rollout, acknowledgment tracking, documentation controls, compliance tracking, audit support, and country policy coordination. Outcome: policies are understood, documentation is reliable, governance is consistent and fair.
   

  

* Modernisation and AI enablement


 Anchanto expects AI to reshape internal operating models. This role identifies repetitive manual work and removes it through automation, digital first workflows, and AI assisted support where it adds real value. Examples: AI assisted Anchanter support, automated onboarding, workflow reminders and bots, intelligent reporting, and digital documentation. We want a builder, not a maintainer.
   

  

* Team leadership and capability building


 Build and lead the Talent Operations team. Set clear ownership and accountability, raise operational discipline, and grow the capability of the function as Anchanto scales. Foster a culture of continuous improvement where the team solves problems rather than escalates them, and develop people so the function gets stronger over time, not just busier. Outcome: a capable, accountable, self\-improving team that leadership can rely on.
   

  

**Cross Functional Operating Model**
 Success depends on clean handoffs and clear ownership boundaries with:
   

  

**Partner**
**On What**
 CHRO / Head of People
   

  

 People strategy, organisation design, transformation
   

  

 HRBP teams
   

  

 Hiring to onboarding handover, performance and talent cycles
   

  

 Talent Acquisition
   

  

 Offer to onboarding transition, candidate to Anchanter handoff
   

  

 Finance
   

  

 Cost control, payroll funding and reconciliation, audit. Payroll is run by an external provider; this role owns and submits the inputs
   

  

 IT and Security
   

  

 HR systems, integrations, access and permissions
   

  

 Business leaders
   

  

 Operational experience, workforce reporting, decision support
   

  

**What Good Looks Like After 12 To 18 Months**
 Leadership should be able to say:
   

  

* People Operations feels enterprise grade.
* Payroll inputs and lifecycle operations are highly reliable.
* People data is trusted, accurate, and easy to access.
* Anchanters get faster and clearer support.
* Manual work and operational friction have dropped significantly.
* HRBPs and leaders spend far less time on administrative coordination.
* Talent Operations runs proactively, not reactively.
* The operational experience is consistent across all countries, not just the largest ones.
* The Talent Operations team is capable, accountable, and improving on its own.


**Skills And Experience**
* 12 to 20 years across Talent Operations, HR Operations, People Operations, or HR shared services, with time spent leading the function, not only running it.
* Experience in technology, SaaS, internet, or fast scaling companies.
* Multi country People Operations experience.
* Strong payroll and compliance governance exposure, with a clear view of where the Finance boundary sits.
* Hands on experience implementing and running HRMS and ATS platforms.
* Strong data and reporting orientation, comfortable building dashboards and reading them for risk.
* Experience managing operational teams and vendors.
* Exposure to automation and AI enabled workflows preferred.
* Able to operate in ambiguity and build structure in a scaling environment.


**Leadership Behaviours We Expect**
 Managers at Anchanto are expected to operate with high ownership, solve problems rather than escalate confusion, use systems and data over opinions, communicate clearly and directly, build trust through reliability, improve processes continuously, collaborate without bureaucracy, and act with urgency and accountability.
   

  

**What This Role Is Not**
 To be clear about scope, this role is not:
   

  

* Payroll only administration.
* An HRBP substitute.

title: Assistant Manager Welfare & Admin
description:
Welfare, Facility \& transportation:
 



  





 ● Manage day to Facilities upkeep \& canteen operations. He should manage vendor contracts as a
 



 primary statutory welfare service, ensuring high standards of food hygiene, quality, and subsidized
 



 nutritional offerings for all workers.
 



 ● Oversee employee transportation including e.i staff buses, taxis, and company vehicles to ensure safe,
 



 reliable daily commuting for a smooth employee experience.
 



 ● Manage plant facilities, timely uniform distribution, printing/stationery, and overall site amenities to
 



 maintain a functional, comfortable working environment.
 



 ● Manage and govern welfare budgets (Capex and Opex), oversee purchasing/contract renewals, and
 



 track vendor performance to ensure uninterrupted delivery of worker\-centric services.
 



 ● Oversee plant security operations and implement the Structured Security Operating Manual and SOPs
 



 to protect employees, conduct site audits, and maintain business continuity.
 



  





 Statutory compliance \& liaison:
 



 ● Directly manage and maintain statutory welfare provisions under statutory code, driving occupational
 



 health and hygiene in collaboration with safety officers through periodic health surveillance, worker
 



 medical examinations, clean drinking water supply, gender\-segregated latrines/urinals, and PPE
 



 utilization monitoring.
 



 ● Oversee 100% worker enrollment under ESI and EPF schemes, process Maternity Benefit applications,
 



 manage Workmen's Compensation claims, and advise workers on leave, gratuity, and statutory
 



 entitlements.
 



 ● Maintain direct relations with government administration and statutory authorities—including the
 



 District Collectorate, Labour/Factory Inspectors, Police, and local bodies—to ensure full legal
 



 compliance, best practice adoption, and smooth plant operations.
 



  





 Engagement \& grievance handling:
 



 ● Resolve worker grievances, maintain the Welfare Complaints Register, counsel employees on
 



 personal or domestic challenges, and facilitate active Works Committee and Joint Welfare Committee
 



 meetings.
 



 ● Conduct orientation sessions for new hires, lead health/safety awareness drives, and organize
 



 employee engagement, sports, and cultural events to foster workplace morale.
 



  





 Qualifications:
 



 The incumbent should be a graduate with a Degree or Diploma in Social Work / Labour Welfare / Personnel
 



 Management / Social Science from a recognised institution.
 



 The incumbent should have handled welfare activities for manufacturing set up in the past for a minimum
 



 two years.

title: HR Operations Specialist
description:
Our Company
   

  

 We're Hitachi Digital, a company at the forefront of digital transformation and the fastest growing division of Hitachi Group. We're crucial to the company's strategy and ambition to become a premier global player in the massive and fast\-moving digital transformation market.
   

  

 Our group companies, including GlobalLogic, Hitachi Digital Services, Hitachi Vantara and more, offer comprehensive services that span the entire digital lifecycle, from initial idea to full\-scale operation and the infrastructure to run it on. Hitachi Digital represents One Hitachi, integrating domain knowledge and digital capabilities, and harnessing the power of the entire portfolio of services, technologies, and partnerships, to accelerate synergy creation and make real\-world impact for our customers and society as a whole.
   

  

 Imagine the sheer breadth of talent it takes to unleash a digital future. We don't expect you to 'fit' every requirement – your life experience, character, perspective, and passion for achieving great things in the world are equally as important to us.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About the Role**
**We are looking for a highly organized and detail\-oriented Sr. Associate, HR Shared Services to join our team in India. This role is critical in providing prompt, accurate, and consistent HR support to our employees. The ideal candidate will primarily manage the end\-to\-end onboarding process for new hires and efficiently resolve employee inquiries through our ticketing system.**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Employee Onboarding
* Manage the complete pre\-boarding and onboarding lifecycle for new employees in India.
* Ensure timely collection, verification, and processing of all required new hire documentation (e.g., identity proof, education certificates, background check forms).
* Coordinate with internal teams (e.g., IT, Payroll, Facilities) to ensure a seamless Day 1 experience, including system access, equipment setup, and workspace readiness.
* Conduct HR\-related induction and orientation sessions, explaining company policies, benefits, and HR processes.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records in the HRIS (Human Resources Information System).
* HR Ticket Handling and Query Resolution
* Serve as the first point of contact for HR\-related queries from employees, managers, and external partners via the HR Shared Services ticketing system.
* Efficiently manage and resolve a high volume of tickets related to various HR topics, including policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), benefits, and data changes.
* Ensure all tickets are logged, categorized, tracked, and resolved within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Escalate complex or specialized issues to the appropriate HR Centers of Excellence (CoE) or other departments, ensuring a smooth handoff and follow\-up.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of the knowledge base by documenting resolutions and frequently asked questions (FAQs).
* Compliance and Audit Support
* Ensure strict compliance with all local Indian labor laws and company policies during the onboarding and record\-keeping processes.
* Support internal and external HR audits by providing necessary documentation and data.


**Required**
**Qualifications and Skills**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Experience: 3\-5 years of experience in an HR Shared Services or HR Operations role, preferably with a focus on onboarding in a large\-scale or multi\-state environment in India.
* Knowledge: Solid understanding of core HR processes and Indian statutory compliance related to hiring and employee documentation.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in using an HRIS (e.g., SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, Oracle) and experience with a ticketing system (e.g., ServiceNow, Zendesk).


**Preferred**
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Proven ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
* A strong customer service mindset, with a proactive approach to problem\-solving.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.


**About Us**
 We're a global, 1000\-strong, diverse team of professional experts, promoting and delivering Social Innovation through our One Hitachi initiative (OT x IT x Product) and working on projects that have a real\-world impact. We're curious, passionate and empowered, blending our legacy of 110 years of innovation with our shaping our future. Here you're not just another employee; you're part of a tradition of excellence and a community working towards creating a digital future.
   

  

 Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives
   

  

 Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.
   

  

 We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit\-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
   

  

 How we look after you
   

  

 We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry\-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.
   

  

*We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic.* 
 Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

title: HR Intern
description:
**Company Description** 
 Gun for Glory Shooting Academy is a world\-class training institution dedicated to nurturing young talent in the sport of shooting. Founded by Olympian Gagan Narang (Padmashri) and Shri Pawan Singh, the academy focuses on developing future champions through structured and scientific coaching. Located at the Shiv Chhatrapati Sports Complex 50m shooting range in Balewadi, Pune, it offers advanced infrastructure and specialized support services, including foreign coaches, sports injury management, physiotherapy, yoga, nutrition, and performance psychology. Training plans are customized using SWOT analysis, and shooters benefit from facilities such as gun testing, SCATT systems, video analysis, and equipment control. The academy operates across 17 centers pan India, providing broad exposure and growth opportunities for both athletes and staff.
   

**Role Description** 
 The HR Intern will support the Human Resources function in a full\-time, on\-site role based in Pune City. Daily responsibilities include assisting with recruitment activities, coordinating interviews, maintaining employee records, and supporting onboarding and orientation processes. The intern will help in drafting and updating HR documents, tracking attendance and leave, and assisting in the administration of employee benefits and policies. The role also involves supporting HR data entry and reporting, helping organize training and engagement activities, and responding to basic employee queries under the guidance of the HR team. This position offers practical exposure to HR operations in a dynamic sports academy environment and the opportunity to learn from experienced HR professionals.

* Candidates should possess an understanding of HR Policies and Employee Benefits.

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree/diploma in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Strong communication skills, attention to detail, and ability to handle confidential information responsibly.
* Proficiency in MS Office and comfort working with HR data and documentation.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a structured environment and manage time effectively.
* Interest in the sports sector and willingness to learn in a fast\-paced academy setting.
